capabilities: Search notes semantically and by keyword
Compile, reformat and edit notes via approved diffs
Quiz on courses and suggest concept links
Process daily notes and suggest vault improvements
extras: Free and open source (MIT), with no accounts, API keys or telemetry. Part of the author's local-first 'Companion' suite. Requires a local model server (Ollama by default; LM Studio, llama.cpp, Jan or vLLM also work), a tool-calling chat model and an embedding model; a GPU-capable machine (about 12 GB VRAM recommended) is needed for good speed. A beta channel is available via BRAT.
motivation: For people who want an assistant that works on the vault without anything leaving the machine; part of a local-first Companion suite for students and researchers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run an AI that searches, compiles and edits notes across the vault without sending your data to a cloud service.

relations.evidence: When Lecture Companion is installed and enabled, the agent reads its records through its API
Copilot with a frontier model will answer harder questions than a 9B model on your GPU

summary: Local agentic AI assistant that searches, compiles and edits notes via Ollama, showing every change as a diff you approve.
